# artisanvirt_vm_gpu (Resource)

Passes a GPU PCI slot, or a pre-provisioned SR-IOV virtual function, through to a VM. The VM must be a stopped Q35/UEFI VM without snapshots, so set `power_state = "stopped"` on the VM while attaching or detaching. The device's IOMMU group must already be bound to `vfio-pci`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artisanvirt_vm" "ml" {
  name        = "ml01"
  node_id     = artisanvirt_node.gpu01.id
  vcpus       = 16
  memory_mib  = 65536
  firmware    = "uefi"
  disks       = [{ size_gib = 200 }]
  power_state = "stopped" # GPUs attach only to stopped VMs
}

resource "artisanvirt_vm_gpu" "a100" {
  vm_id   = artisanvirt_vm.ml.id
  address = "0000:41:00.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) PCI address, e.g. `0000:01:00.0`.
- `vm_id` (String)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `devices` (List of String) PCI functions assigned with the GPU (its IOMMU group members).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <vm_id>/<pci_address>
terraform import artisanvirt_vm_gpu.a100 vm-0123456789abcdef/0000:41:00.0
```
